# Bagian 8 dari sepuluh berkas (75-84). Tetap 1:1, harfiah ("=").

=At the end of an enemy unit's action, if it is within <color=#f26c1c>6 tiles</color>, Faye throws a tomahawk at it, gains <color=#f26c1c>1 point</color> of Confectance Index, applies <color=#f26c1c>1 stack</color> of <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> to it, and deals Physical damage equal to <color=#f26c1c>80%</color> of attack and <color=#f26c1c>2 points</color> of stability damage.
column2: Di akhir aksi unit musuh, jika dia berada <color=#f26c1c>dalam 6 tile</color>, Faye melempar tomahawk kepadanya, mendapatkan <color=#f26c1c>1 poin</color> Confectance Index, menerapkan <color=#f26c1c>1 stack</color> <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> kepadanya, lalu memberikan Physical damage setara <color=#f26c1c>80%</color> Attack dan <color=#f26c1c>2 poin</color> Stability damage.

column1: =If the enemy is within <color=#f26c1c>3 tiles</color>, Faye performs an axe whirl instead; gains <color=#f26c1c>1 point</color> of Confectance Index, applies <color=#f26c1c>2 stacks</color> of <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> to all enemy units within <color=#f26c1c>3 tiles</color>, and deals AoE Physical damage equal to <color=#f26c1c>60%</color> of attack and <color=#f26c1c>1 point</color> of stability damage.
column2: Jika musuhnya berada <color=#f26c1c>dalam 3 tile</color>, Faye justru memutar kapaknya; mendapatkan <color=#f26c1c>1 poin</color> Confectance Index, menerapkan <color=#f26c1c>2 stack</color> <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> ke semua unit musuh <color=#f26c1c>dalam 3 tile</color>, lalu memberikan AoE Physical damage setara <color=#f26c1c>60%</color> Attack dan <color=#f26c1c>1 poin</color> Stability damage.

column1: =If the enemy is within <color=#f26c1c>3 tiles</color>, Faye gains Confectance Index, applies <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> to all enemy units within <color=#f26c1c>3 tiles</color>, and deals AoE Physical damage and stability damage.
column2: Jika musuhnya berada <color=#f26c1c>dalam 3 tile</color>, Faye mendapatkan Confectance Index, menerapkan <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> ke semua unit musuh <color=#f26c1c>dalam 3 tile</color>, lalu memberikan AoE Physical damage dan Stability damage.

column1: =When attacking, Faye ignores an amount of the target's defense and recovers HP based on the number of <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> stacks they hold.
column2: Saat menyerang, Faye mengabaikan sebagian Defense target lalu memulihkan HP berdasarkan jumlah stack <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> yang mereka memiliki.

column1: =At the start of the turn, Jiangyu gains <color=#f26c1c>1 point</color> of Confectance Index.
column2: Di awal giliran, Jiangyu mendapatkan <color=#f26c1c>1 poin</color> Confectance Index.

column1: =Jiangyu gains Confectance Index at the start of the turn.
column2: Jiangyu mendapatkan Confectance Index di awal giliran.

column1: =At the end of the action, if Confectance Index is full, expends all points of Confectance Index and reduces the cooldown of the Ultimate skill <color=#3487e0>Rolling Thunder</color> by <color=#f26c1c>1 turn</color>.
column2: Di akhir aksi, jika Confectance Index penuh, menghabiskan seluruh poin Confectance Index lalu mengurangi cooldown skill Ultimate <color=#3487e0>Rolling Thunder</color> <color=#f26c1c>1 giliran</color>.

column1: =When enemy units gain <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> multiple times, applies 1 stack of <color=#3487e0>{1}</color> to them for <color=#f26c1c>2 turns</color>.

column1: =When enemy units gain <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> multiple times, applies <color=#3487e0>{1}</color> to them.
column2: Saat unit musuh mendapatkan <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> berkali-kali, menerapkan <color=#3487e0>{1}</color> kepada mereka.
